conventionNote: Funding is paid hourly on the Hyperliquid HIP-3 premium formula times a per-market multiplier (0.6 on most para markets, 0.1 on the rate markets), and fees are the HIP-3 schedule of twice the Hyperliquid base at deployerFeeScale 1.0 (3 bps maker, 9 bps taker at tier 0), cut by 90 percent on growth-mode markets, with half going to the deployer.
